name: Radiant Blue Ioun Stone
source: Pathfinder #126: Beyond the Veiled Past pg. 36
body:
Source Pathfinder #126: Beyond the Veiled Past pg. 36
Aura strong varied CL 12th
Slot none; Price —; Weight —
Description
A radiant blue sphere ioun stone grants a +4 enhancement bonus to Wisdom while active.
Destruction
This stone can be destroyed like any other ioun stone, except it has AC 26, 50 hit points, and hardness 10.
